description: Look up full LinkedIn profiles for up to 100 people and store their current title, company, headline and job history (every position). Job history is what get_outreach_path (coworker / alumni paths) and get_alumni_engagers search, and engagers collected from reactions/comments have none until enriched — when those tools report missing coverage they return a _meta.next_step with the exact person_ids to pass here. Pass person_ids (people.id from any engager / path tool) and/or linkedin_urls. Costs 3 credits per person successfully enriched. People enriched in the last 90 days are skipped for free unless refresh=true; failed or not-found lookups are free. The balance must cover 3 × the people to be looked up (after skips and max_credits) before anything runs; you are charged only for successes.

linkedin_urls.description: LinkedIn profile URLs to enrich; people not yet in the graph are added

max_credits.description: Spend cap. At most floor(max_credits / 3) people are looked up; the rest come back skipped_budget.

refresh.description: Re-enrich people enriched within the last 90 days (bypasses the cache)
